primary.$description: Primary theme color. Main brand color for primary CTAs, links, and key interactive elements. Use for primary buttons, active navigation, focus states. Bootstrap's --bs-primary maps to blue-500. Ensures consistent brand expression across all touchpoints. Verify 4.5:1 contrast on backgrounds.

success.$description: Success theme color. Positive feedback, confirmations, and successful operations. Use for success messages, checkmarks, positive badges, form validation. Bootstrap's --bs-success maps to green-500. Universal indicator of positive outcomes. Ensure 4.5:1 with backgrounds.

body-color.$description: Default body text color. Applied to the <body> element and inherited by all text content unless overridden.

body-bg.$description: Default body background color. Applied to the <body> element as the base page background.

emphasis-color.$description: Emphasis color for higher contrast text. Use for headings or text that needs to stand out.

secondary-color.$description: Secondary text color for lighter, less prominent text. Use for captions, labels, or helper text.

secondary-bg.$description: Secondary background color. Use for dividers and to indicate disabled component states.

tertiary-color.$description: Tertiary text color for even lighter text. Use for less important supporting text.

tertiary-bg.$description: Tertiary background color. Use for hover states, accents, and wells.

link-color.$description: Default hyperlink color. Used for all <a> elements and interactive text.

link-hover-color.$description: Hyperlink hover color. Applied when user hovers over a link.

border-color.$description: Default border color for component borders, dividers, and rules.

primary-text-emphasis.$description: Primary text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

primary-bg-subtle.$description: Primary subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

primary-border-subtle.$description: Primary subtle border color for gentle borders matching primary theme.

secondary-text-emphasis.$description: Secondary theme text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

secondary-bg-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

secondary-border-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle border color for gentle borders matching secondary theme.

success-text-emphasis.$description: Success text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

success-bg-subtle.$description: Success subtle background color for non-intrusive success states.

success-border-subtle.$description: Success subtle border color for gentle borders matching success theme.

danger-text-emphasis.$description: Danger text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

danger-bg-subtle.$description: Danger subtle background color for non-intrusive error states.

danger-border-subtle.$description: Danger subtle border color for gentle borders matching danger theme.

warning-text-emphasis.$description: Warning text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

info-text-emphasis.$description: Info text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

primary.$description: Primary theme color. Main brand color for primary CTAs, links, and key interactive elements. Use for primary buttons, active navigation, focus states. Bootstrap's --bs-primary maps to blue-500. Ensures consistent brand expression across all touchpoints. Verify 4.5:1 contrast on backgrounds.

success.$description: Success theme color. Positive feedback, confirmations, and successful operations. Use for success messages, checkmarks, positive badges, form validation. Bootstrap's --bs-success maps to green-500. Universal indicator of positive outcomes. Ensure 4.5:1 with backgrounds.

body-color.$description: Default body text color. Applied to the <body> element and inherited by all text content unless overridden.

body-bg.$description: Default body background color. Applied to the <body> element as the base page background.

emphasis-color.$description: Emphasis color for higher contrast text. Use for headings or text that needs to stand out.

secondary-color.$description: Secondary text color for lighter, less prominent text. Use for captions, labels, or helper text.

secondary-bg.$description: Secondary background color. Use for dividers and to indicate disabled component states.

tertiary-color.$description: Tertiary text color for even lighter text. Use for less important supporting text.

tertiary-bg.$description: Tertiary background color. Use for hover states, accents, and wells.

link-color.$description: Default hyperlink color. Used for all <a> elements and interactive text.

link-hover-color.$description: Hyperlink hover color. Applied when user hovers over a link.

border-color.$description: Default border color for component borders, dividers, and rules.

primary-text-emphasis.$description: Primary text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

primary-bg-subtle.$description: Primary subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

primary-border-subtle.$description: Primary subtle border color for gentle borders matching primary theme.

secondary-text-emphasis.$description: Secondary theme text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

secondary-bg-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle background color for non-intrusive backgrounds.

secondary-border-subtle.$description: Secondary theme subtle border color for gentle borders matching secondary theme.

success-text-emphasis.$description: Success text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

success-bg-subtle.$description: Success subtle background color for non-intrusive success states.

success-border-subtle.$description: Success subtle border color for gentle borders matching success theme.

danger-text-emphasis.$description: Danger text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

danger-bg-subtle.$description: Danger subtle background color for non-intrusive error states.

danger-border-subtle.$description: Danger subtle border color for gentle borders matching danger theme.

warning-text-emphasis.$description: Warning text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

warning-bg-subtle.$description: Warning subtle background color for non-intrusive warning states.

warning-border-subtle.$description: Warning subtle border color for gentle borders matching warning theme.

info-text-emphasis.$description: Info text emphasis color - higher contrast text on light backgrounds.

info-bg-subtle.$description: Info subtle background color for non-intrusive info states.

info-border-subtle.$description: Info subtle border color for gentle borders matching info theme.

light-text-emphasis.$description: Light text emphasis color - provides contrast on light themed components.

light-bg-subtle.$description: Light subtle background color for subtle backgrounds.

light-border-subtle.$description: Light subtle border color for gentle borders matching light theme.

dark-text-emphasis.$description: Dark text emphasis color - highest contrast text on light backgrounds.

dark-bg-subtle.$description: Dark subtle background color for darker backgrounds.

dark-border-subtle.$description: Dark subtle border color for borders matching dark theme.

xs.$description: Extra small breakpoint for portrait phones (min-width: 0). Bootstrap's default mobile-first starting point.

0.$description: Border radius: 0 - No rounding. Used for completely square corners. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-0' utility class.

sm.$description: Border radius: Small - .25rem (4px). Used for subtle rounding on small components. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-1' utility class and $border-radius-sm variable.

default.$description: Border radius: Default - .375rem (6px). The standard rounding used throughout Bootstrap for most components. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded' or 'rounded-2' utility classes and $border-radius variable.

lg.$description: Border radius: Large - .5rem (8px). Used for larger, more prominent rounded corners. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-3' utility class and $border-radius-lg variable.

xl.$description: Border radius: Extra Large - 1rem (16px). Used for very prominent rounded corners on large components. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-4' utility class and $border-radius-xl variable.

xxl.$description: Border radius: 2X Extra Large - 2rem (32px). Used for dramatically rounded corners creating a softer, more modern appearance. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-5' utility class and $border-radius-xxl variable.

circle.$description: Border radius: Circle - 50%. Creates perfectly circular shapes when applied to square elements. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-circle' utility class. Note: This is a percentage value (50%), not pixel-based.

pill.$description: Border radius: Pill - 50rem (800px). Creates pill-shaped elements with fully rounded ends on rectangular shapes. Equivalent to Bootstrap's 'rounded-pill' utility class and $border-radius-pill variable.

base.$description: Primary font family for Figma (single font name). Full Bootstrap stack: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, etc.

platform.fontStack: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, sans-serif

monospace.$description: Monospace font for code (single font name). Full Bootstrap stack: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, etc.

platform.fontStack: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

xs.$description: Extra small line height (1.0 ratio) - Compact UI, tags, badges. Use sparingly, not for body text. 4pt scale: 16px.

sm.$description: Small line height (1.25 ratio) - Bootstrap $line-height-sm. Compact text, small UI elements, tight spacing. Below WCAG AA for body text. 4pt scale: 20px.

tight.$description: Tight line height (1.2-1.25 ratio) - Display fonts, headings (h1-h6). Improves readability of large text. Bootstrap heading default. 4pt scale: 20px for 16px base.

base.$description: Base line height (1.5 ratio) - Bootstrap $line-height-base. Default for body text. WCAG AA compliant (1.5 minimum). 4pt scale: 24px for 16px base font.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed line height (1.75 ratio) - Enhanced readability for long-form content, articles, documentation. Exceeds WCAG AA. 4pt scale: 28px.

lg.$description: Large line height (2.0 ratio) - Bootstrap $line-height-lg. Spacious text, large UI components, improved scannability. 4pt scale: 32px.

display-sm.$description: Small display line height (1.2 ratio for 40px text) - Display fonts, large headings. Tighter leading for visual impact. 4pt scale: 48px.

display-md.$description: Medium display line height (1.2 ratio for 48-56px text) - Medium display fonts. 4pt scale: 60px.

display-lg.$description: Large display line height (1.2 ratio for 64px text) - Large display fonts, hero headings. 4pt scale: 76px (closest to 1.2 ratio).
